con:soapui-project.name: integration-tests
con:soapui-project.con:description:
Logon integration test suite. It is possible to start the tests by ant task, see adnant -p.
Main project properties:
testhosturl: the host where Logon listens to incoming messages, including the port Incoming messages are stored in logon/wsdumps/incoming-... directories -> you can check if the message had been received or not
ldstologonportpath: the full path where logon receives LDS messages, can be specified by the ant task 'ldstologonportpath' attribute mopeventportpath: the full path where logon receives PDA messages, can be specified by the ant task 'mopeventportpath' attribute ...
How to spot if there is a port problem? Open localhost:8080/logon/init/versionCheck there look for host.url entries, those are the ones which define where Logon expects or sends messages. It's suggested to always keep in mind that response for a certain request is sometimes not what the tests expect. Example: create order test: response is OK and the order, but it expects a followup REQUEST which has to follow the RESPONSE received for the request the pda initiated.
PDA --> Logon REQUEST1 Logon --> PDA RESPONSE 1 (OK) PDA expects: Logon --> PDA REQUEST 2 PDA --> Logon RESPONSE 2 (OK)
sometimes even more complicated: PDA waiting LDS -->Logon REQUEST1 (startLoad) Logon -->LDS RESPONSE (OK, etc.) PDA expects: Logon -->PDA REQUEST (loadingStarted) PDA -->Logon RESPONSE (OK, etc.)
tests are sometimes hard to unterstand, try to look for description: https://aww.adnovum.ch/twiki/bin/view/CrhPegasus/HowToSoapUITest

<xsd:schema targetNamespace="http://logon.holcim.com/LogonLDSInterface/common_out" xmlns:tns="http://logon.holcim.com/LogonLDSInterface/common_out" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <xsd:complexType name="header"> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="clientType" type="xsd:string"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Technical field to indicate the logical sender of the message. LOGON, FENICS, WeWaS or Parallel.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="senderInfo" type="xsd:string"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Technical identifier of the system sending the message. For example "LOGON-LAN-FBNL".</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="sendersTime" type="xsd:dateTime"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Date/time the message was sent.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="language" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Language of the error messages.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ldsRequestId"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>LDS Identification of the request. This id is solely used to be sent back in the response in order to easier link the request message to the response messages. This id is not stored in LOGON nor has it any functionality in LOGON.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="64"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> <xsd:complexType abstract="true" name="request"> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="header" type="tns:header"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> <xsd:complexType abstract="true" name="response"> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="header" type="tns:header"/> <xsd:element name="code" type="xsd:string"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Error code</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="txt" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Error description</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> <xsd:complexType name="loadOrderData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Corresponds to an assignment?</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="loadOrderId"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Uniquely identifies a load order. Guarantees that the same order can be loaded more than once (i.e. in case of re-routing).</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="25"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="supplyPlantNo"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>SAP plant number (from which goods are issued). Important if an LDS uses a central server (and not one per plant) to know for which plant message is relevant.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="4"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="shippingpointNo"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>SAP shipping point number (from which goods are issued).</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="4"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="1" name="loadOrderItem" type="tns:loadOrderItemData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>The actual loads to be loaded. Each corresponds to a row of TLGNC_LOAD.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="scheduling" type="tns:schedulingData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Scheduling related data common to all loads (loadOrderItems) of that load order.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="vehicle" type="tns:vehicleData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>The vehicle to be loaded.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0" name="order" type="tns:orderData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Commercial orders.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="noteLds"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Remark for operator of LDS and/or truck driver. To be displayed somewhere on the LDS screen.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="256"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> <xsd:complexType name="loadOrderItemData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Corresponds to a row of TLGNC_LOAD.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="loadOrderItemId"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>ID of the load order item. TLGNC_LOAD.LOAD_ID.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="12"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="material" type="tns:materialData" minOccurs="0"/> <xsd:element name="loadingpointNo" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Identification number of the loading point in the LDS. This is a non-LOGON identifier of this loading point and must be unique in combination with shippingpointNo. If set, loading is only allowed at this loading point (e.g. specific silo at cement plant). If empty, all loading points are allowed.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="12"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="exactDeliveryQuantity" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Instead of entering a quantity, this flag allows to fill the vehicle to its max capacity. False = fill the vehicle up to max capacity [maxGrossWeight - (measured)tareWeight] True = fill the vehicle up to quantity defined in quantity and quantityUom.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="chamberNo"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>The chamber to be loaded with this load.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:decimal"> <xsd:totalDigits value="3"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> <xsd:complexType name="materialData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Data related to a single material.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="materialNo" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Optional because of the case of planning materials, where the field is left empty.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="18"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="contractItemNumber" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>SAP contract item number. Can be set if delivery was created by LDS (in this case only this mixDesign is allowed).</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="18"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="quantity" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Quantity of the material to be loaded in the unit of measure defined by 'quantityUom'.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:decimal"> <xsd:totalDigits value="12"/> <xsd:fractionDigits value="4"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="quantityPerDelivery" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Used to split the order into several deliveries. LDS must enfore the correct sequence of loading.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> <xsd:complexType name="vehicleData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Vehicle data (identification etc.).</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="commercialCarrier" type="tns:vendorData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Commercial carrier (forwarding agent).</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="executingCarrier" minOccurs="0" type="tns:vendorData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Executing carrier (subcontractor).</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="vehicleType"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>LOGON vehicle type.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="30"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="allowedVehicleType" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>List of vehicle types allowed to load this load order.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="30"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="truckId"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>LOGON truck id.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="12"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="truckPlateNo" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Truck plate number. E.g. if a physical truck, wagon or ship etc. or an external vehicle (pick-up) needs to be loaded. Possible values (to be checked) - road direct (outbound) - road direct (inbound) -> landfill - exPlant - toPlant (E.G. landfill wich is delivered from a 3rd party to the plant)</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="4"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="earliestDeliveryTime" type="xsd:dateTime" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Earliest delivery time of order (customer time windows). If not set, actual date/time is used [createCustomerOrder]. For information only [loadOrderNotification, etc.]</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="latestDeliveryTime" type="xsd:dateTime" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Latest delivery time of order (customer time window). If not set, the ship-to’s closing time of the same day is used (must be bigger than ‘now’) [createCustomerOrder]. For information only [loadOrderNotification, etc.].</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="plannedDeliveryTime" type="xsd:dateTime" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Planned delivery time (arriving time at customer site in case of delivered, pick-up time in case of EXW deliveries). If not set, LOGON sets ‘actual date/time’ [createCustomerOrder]. For information only [loadOrderNotification, etc.].</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="orderValidationCode" minOccurs="0"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Order validation code.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="10"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="orderListItem" type="tns:orderListItemData" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Order item (TLGNC_ORDER_ITEM), but only reduced order item data, which is appropriate in a message containing multiple orders.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> </xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> <xsd:complexType name="orderListItemData"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Corresponds to a row of TLGNC_ORDER_ITEM, but only reduced item data, which is appropriate in a message, where multiple orders might be present.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="logonOrderItemNumber" minOccurs="1"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>LOGON order item number.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:decimal"> <xsd:totalDigits value="3"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="materialNo" minOccurs="1"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>SAP material number</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="18"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="quantity" minOccurs="1"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>Quantity of the material to be loaded in the unit of measure defined by 'quantityUom'.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:decimal"> <xsd:totalDigits value="12"/> <xsd:fractionDigits value="4"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> <xsd:element name="quantityUom" minOccurs="1"> <xsd:annotation> <xsd:documentation>The unit of measure 'quantity' is measured in. Must be SAP base UoM, sales UoM or any UoM which is defined in alternative UoM of the material.</xsd:documentation> </xsd:annotation> <xsd:simpleType> <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string"> <xsd:maxLength value="3"/> </xsd:restriction> </xsd:simpleType> </xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:schema>

Sequence diagram: - /share/doc/crh/pegasus/spec/tech/PDA/magic/UC_9010_Login_PDA_Sequence.png

con:testCase.name: Preload with order
con:testCase.con:description:
The test suite is performing CH Parallel integration tests. 3 cases are possible: 1. load wagon for which order is already assigned to the wagon 2. load wagon for which order is not yet assigned, but could be loaded - preload type 1 3. load wagon with material (without order) - preload type 2
Edit etc/soapui/CH-Parallel-Testsuite properties, it is possible to load the proper attributes from there for each step.
